capabilities: Renders notes through Obsidian into static HTML
Publishes Dataview, Bases and Mermaid output
Publishes HTML prototypes and their referenced files
Encrypts a published site behind a password
Publishes to GitHub Pages through the Git Data API
extras: Desktop-only; publishing requires a running Obsidian. Documentation is hosted on a published site. Also includes a comment/review overlay and a Figma-like prototype editor; password protection is a shared secret, not access control.
motivation: To publish Dataview, Bases and Mermaid output without reimplementing them outside Obsidian.
problem: Publishing a vault as a static site usually loses Dataview, Bases and Mermaid output because external converters cannot render them.

relations.evidence: Dataview, Datacore, Bases and Mermaid output exists only inside a running Obsidian.
commits the built site through the Git Data API and points GitHub Pages at the branch.
a panel that works like Figma's.

requires.name: VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf or Zed

summary: Static-site publisher that renders vault notes through Obsidian so Dataview, Bases and Mermaid output survives in the published HTML.
